props.name: bounces
props.description:
Native list bounce at the edges (ignored on the PTR list, which forces it
off so the top-edge pull isn't stolen).

props.name: enableBounce
props.description:
Rubber-band overscroll bounce at both edges that springs back on release.
Independent of `enableRefresh`: enable it alone for a bounce-only list, or
alongside refresh to add a bottom-edge bounce (the top edge already bounces
while pulling to refresh).

props.name: enableRefresh
props.description:
Enable the rubber-band pull-to-refresh. Off → a bare `<list>`, no touch
handlers.

props.name: itemKey
props.description: Alternative to `itemKeyField`: a function returning the key. Wins if both set.

props.name: itemKeyField
props.description:
Field on `T` used as the unique key per row. Required by Lynx's `<list>`
for diffing — unstable keys recycle rows wrong. The native diff appends /
removes by key but does NOT reorder, so when the data order changes (e.g. a
refresh) replace the keys rather than permuting existing ones.

props.name: items
props.description: Items to render. Each becomes a `<list-item>` with an `item-key`.

props.name: itemSnap
props.type: boolean | { factor: number; offset: number; } | undefined
props.description:
Native `<list>` `item-snap` paging. `true` snaps each item to the top
(`{ factor: 0, offset: 0 }`, full-screen paging); pass an object for a
custom factor/offset. `listType: 'single'` only.

props.name: loadMoreThresholdItemCount
props.description: Items from the bottom that triggers `load-more`.

props.name: noMoreData
props.description:
No more data to load. Shows the `noMoreDataFooter` slot (end-of-list). Until
this is `true` — and while not `loadingMore` — no footer renders, so a list
with more pages to fetch never displays an "end of list" message.

props.name: refreshThreshold
props.description: Pull distance (px) past which release triggers a refresh.

props.name: upperThresholdItemCount
props.description: Items from the top that triggers `scrollToUpper`.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Row template. Receives the item and its current index.

slots.name: refreshHeader
slots.description:
Pull-to-refresh header. `state` is the current refresh state; `progress` is
the pull distance as a fraction of `refreshThreshold` (0..1, clamped).

slots.name: loadMoreFooter
slots.description: Shown at the bottom while `loadingMore` is true.

slots.name: noMoreDataFooter
slots.description: Shown at the bottom when there is no more data to load.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Rendered in place of the list when `items` is empty.
